summary: Cumberland County, PA former lookout site; a Blaw-Knox tower the register dates to 1934, but the Staley's Knob entry dates its move to Buck Ridge to 1934 too; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as a former lookout site; no source read says whether the tower was removed or what remains

events.note: First tree tower at Staley's Knob, before the tower moved to Buck Ridge
Wooden tower replaced the 1904 tree tower at Staley's Knob
Wooden tower at Staley's Knob replaced
Register gives 1934 as the build year of the Blaw-Knox tower; conflicts with the Staley's Knob entry (see resolved_conflicts)
Staley's Knob entry: tower moved in 1934 and renamed Buck Ridge

evidence.quote: This Blaw-Knox tower was built in 1934.

evidence.supports: tower moved from Staley Knob in the 1970s (register version)
evidence.quote: It was moved from Staley Knob in the 1970s.

evidence.supports: site is listed under the Former Fire Lookout Sites register
Staley's Knob: first tree tower 1904, wooden tower 1912, replaced 1922, moved 1934 and renamed Buck Ridge
evidence.quote: The first tree tower was built in 1904 and was replaced by a wooden tower in 1912 which was replaced in 1922. The tower was moved in 1934 and renamed Buck Ridge.

evidence.supports: Staley's Knob site is in Adams County
tree observation point 35 feet above the ground, established before 1918
evidence.quote: <1918: A tree observation point established 35-feet above the ground.

corrections.why: The register lists the site as a former lookout, but no text read says the tower was removed or what remains at the site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Buck Ridge entry: built in 1934 and moved from Staley Knob in the 1970s. Staley's Knob entry: moved in 1934 and renamed Buck Ridge. The story gives both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'gone' is not supported by any text read; the register only calls the site former. The 1970s move date appears only in the Buck Ridge entry; Staley's Knob gives 1934. The Staley's Knob entry (Adams County) is a separate record worth checking for consistency. The firelookout.org Pennsylvania inventory URL returned 404 in the crawl cache, so no inventory status was used. Buck Ridge (Mifflin County) is a different site.
